physicalMac.description: Stable per-physical-chip identifier (e.g. ESP32 factory-burned MAC). When provided and it already belongs to a different device, Core reuses that existing device identity instead of creating a duplicate.

hysteresisCelsius.description: Full hysteresis band width in degrees Celsius (heating turns on at target - band/2, off at target + band/2).

formula.description: Required for FORMULA -- the typed AST tree built by the nested tree-builder UI. Validated structurally by DerivedVariableService (every entity id inside must belong to the device).

sourceEntityIdA.description: id of an existing DeviceEntity on the same device -- required for every operation except FORMULA, whose sources live inside the formula tree instead.

sourceEntityIdB.description: id of an existing DeviceEntity on the same device

weightA.description: Only used for WEIGHTED_AVERAGE -- weight given to source A (source B gets 1 - weightA).

windowMinutes.description: Rolling time window in minutes; required for ROLLING_AVERAGE.

baseControlStrategy.description: Owner-configured DEFAULT target-temperature control, used whenever no HeatingSchedule window is currently active. Edited via the Control Strategy panel. Never read directly by firmware -- see controlStrategy for what is actually being applied right now.

boilerEstimateWindowMinutes.description: Rolling-window (minutes) used by both firmware and Core to average (supply+return)/2 into the boiler_temperature_estimate entity.

configurationVersion.description: Bumped on every controlStrategy write; firmware persists the last value it saw and only re-applies a new poll response when this is higher, so a dropped/duplicate poll response can never roll a device back to an older strategy.

controlStrategy.description: What is CURRENTLY effective and pushed to firmware via the GI Edge command-poll response ({ targetTemperatureCelsius, hysteresisCelsius, mode }) -- may be overridden by an active HeatingSchedule window; see baseControlStrategy for the manually-configured default. Null if never set -- firmware treats that as no autonomous control (MANUAL-equivalent).

controlTemperatureEntityId.description: DeviceEntity.id (belonging to this device) whose telemetry readings drive the live control hysteresis decision. Null means live heating control is not wired up for this device.

diagnostics.description: Raw parsed JSON body of the most recent GI Edge heartbeat (currentState/activeFaults/latchedFaults/safetyInterlockActive/wifi rssi/bootCount/resetReason/rebootLoopDetected/relay+sensor readings, shape owned by firmware -- see EnergyController::build_diagnostics_json). Null for LEGACY_ESPHOME devices or a GI_EDGE_V1 device that has not sent a heartbeat yet.

dryRun.description: Testing convenience: while true, the control logic still evaluates and reports what it WOULD do, but firmware never actually writes the relay GPIO. Persistent, pushed to firmware live on every command-poll response -- survives an arbitrarily long offline period the same way controlStrategy does.

fallbackThresholdMs.description: PRD §2: fallback threshold (ms) before the device's own local hysteresis loop takes over as a safety fallback once contact with Core is lost -- pushed to firmware live on every command-poll response.

heatingRelayEntityId.description: DeviceEntity.id (belonging to this device) that the live control service is allowed to command on/off. Null means live heating control is not wired up for this device.

heatingSuspended.description: Hard override: while true, nothing may turn this device's heating relay ON -- not a schedule, not the live-control loop, not a PV boost, not an automation. Turning it further OFF is always still allowed.

lastKnownIp.description: Last known IP: from ESPHome discovery/sync for LEGACY_ESPHOME devices, or the source address of the last GI Edge heartbeat/telemetry request for GI_EDGE_V1 devices.

localControlTemperatureSource.description: Which of firmware's own locally-computed sources (SUPPLY/RETURN/BOILER_ESTIMATE) the device's local (Core-disconnected) fallback control loop compares against.

pumpComparisonEntityId.description: DeviceEntity.id (belonging to this device) whose value drives the pump-staging decision -- typically boiler_temperature_estimate, since the pump must keep circulating until the whole tank is saturated, not just until the heater's own faster-reacting sensor reaches target. Null means pump staging is not wired up for this device.

pumpRelayEntityId.description: DeviceEntity.id (belonging to this device) of an optional second relay (a circulation pump) staged independently from heatingRelayEntityId: it stays on until pumpComparisonEntityId reaches the same controlStrategy target, even after the heater has already turned off. Null means pump staging is not wired up for this device.

pvBoostActive.description: Whether a PV-surplus boost is engaged right now.

pvHeatingConfig.description: PV-surplus heating config blob; null = DISABLED.

activeFaultCount.description: Count of entries in this device's most recent heartbeat diagnostics.activeFaults array. 0 if the device has never sent a heartbeat. Exposed on the list endpoint (not just device details) so a fleet-wide view can flag devices with real faults, not only offline ones.

boilerEstimateWindowMinutes.description: Rolling-window (minutes) used by both firmware and Core to average (supply+return)/2 into the boiler_temperature_estimate entity.

controlTemperatureEntityId.description: DeviceEntity.id (belonging to this device) whose telemetry readings drive the live control hysteresis decision. Null means live heating control is not wired up for this device.

currentState.description: Firmware's own DeviceStateMachine state at the most recent heartbeat (BOOT/SELF_TEST/READY/IDLE/HEATING_REQUESTED/HEATING_VERIFYING/HEATING/STOPPING/FAULT/SAFE_MODE), or null if the device has never sent a heartbeat. Distinct from `status` (connectivity), exposed on the list endpoint so a fleet-wide view can flag a device stuck in FAULT/SAFE_MODE, not only offline ones.

Null means pump staging is not wired up for this device.
